data.title: What Is Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) Looking For In Humanoid Robotics?
data.description: Tencent Holdings (SEHK:700) has joined Alibaba as a lead investor in Xpeng's humanoid robotics spin out Dogotix, backing a US$900 million funding round. The deal marks Tencent's entry into a standalone humanoid robotics venture outside its existing software, platform and cloud operations. Tencent's move highlights growing interest from large Chinese tech companies in AI enabled hardware and robotics projects. For readers who want to look beyond consumer platforms and explore listed...
